findings.reason: as written §6 cannot obtain the quiet node its absolute thresholds (warm roadmap <= 2 s, warm audit <= 3 s, cold roadmap < 30 s) are measured against, so the next dispatch either blocks on its own precondition or reports a load-contaminated pass/fail; naming the partition in the done-when (as §7 does) is the fix.
findings.text: §6 requires the measurement run "on a compute node with no other reckon worker on it", but neither the deliverable nor the done-when names a partition, and the dispatch host submits a separate partition job with RECKON_ALLOW_NESTED_LAUNCH=1 only "when the done-when names one"; §7 obtained its exclusive node by naming `all_debug` explicitly, and the plan's own record (c-s6-second-measurement-1016) shows the second §6 measurement ran on the shared fleet node under load and had to caveat its figures

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `doccheck.derived_plan_age` (doccheck.py:290), `doccheck._plan_last_committed` (doccheck.py:265), `serve._git_last_committed` (serve.py:1850), `serve._git_head` (serve.py:1645), `serve._run_git` (serve.py:1528), commit `c597bb999` (ancestor of HEAD, "count plan age from the last commit"), the `audit_latest`/report path `reads-remeasured-at-head/report.md`, and `health-tool-latency/scripts/profile_reads.py` all resolve; the §17 call chain is real — `mcp.py:2660` calls `doccheck.audit_lifecycle`, whose `derived_plan_age` call is at doccheck.py:712.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §6 declares a negative control (the base revision measured the same way in the same session, which must exceed the deadline), and §17's control ("with the failure not remembered, the no-repository case starts one spawn per plan and the test fails") falsifies the no-repo arm it measures.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — both write evidence "under the run directory" (a durable path under the run's own log/report directory), never a node-local scratch path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach the symbols or the new test filename `tests/test_a_tree_outside_git_asks_once.py`; the commit subject cited in §17's Why is plan prose, not code.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §6 requires "a compute node with no other reckon worker on it" but the section and its done-when name no allocation, so under the dispatch host contract the condition cannot be obtained; the plan's own second measurement failed this way.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §6 is one measurement deliverable; §17 is one memo deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §6's deliverable list now names §16/§17 (the two live implementable sections), matching the only open route f-araiid-013; §17 declares no cross-section relationship that points at a wrong node, and its write paths (`reckon/serve.py`) do not collide with §16 (`reckon/resources.py`).
